question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

He was playing cricket when I have walked past the stadium early in the morning.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error lies in the use of the phrase "**when I have walked**" in Option 2.
 
• The present perfect tense "**have walked**" is incorrect in this context because the sentence's primary tense is past continuous ("**He was playing**").
 
• The correct phrase should be "**when I walked**" to maintain consistency in the past tense.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He was playing cricket when I walked past the stadium early in the morning."*
